title: Adalo Review 2026: Pricing, Features, and Honest Verdict
summary: Adalo is one of the easiest ways to a native app, but it caps published apps and gates push behind its $52 plan. Here's why Blink is the more complete platform for building a real mobile product.
body_markdown:
Blink. It includes push notifications, RevenueCat subscriptions, in-app AI, and a synced GitHub repo, with unlimited team members. More options are compared in our[Adalo alternatives](https://blink.new/blog/adalo-alternatives) guide.


Yes, but only from the $52/mo Professional plan. Blink adds push notifications from a sentence.


No, not provided: no code export is listed on any plan. Blink does it better with a GitHub repo synced both ways from day one.


One on Starter, two on Professional, and five on Team. Blink includes unlimited team members on every plan and builds each app as its own project with its own database.


Yes, a built-in Postgres database on every plan, and that is a real strength. Blink provisions a managed SQL database with row-level security on every project.
